::: {.col-lg-9 .col-sm-12 .prose}
#### An introduction to optimization on smooth manifolds

This book about optimization on smooth manifolds has no prerequisites in geometry or optimization. Chapters 3 and 5 can serve as a standalone introduction to differential and Riemannian geometry, focused on embedded submanifolds of linear spaces, with full proofs and an emphasis on computability. It then builds from there to equip the reader to take on modern research challenges.

::: {.book-link}
[Click here to go to the book webpage](https://www.nicolasboumal.net/book/index.html){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.
:::

Published by [Cambridge University Press](https://cambridge.org/9781009166157){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

You may also be interested in the Manopt toolboxes ([Matlab](https://www.manopt.org){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, [Python](https://www.pymanopt.org){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, [Julia](https://www.manoptjl.org){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}).
